title: Nets' Forward Kevin Durant Appears In Drake & Popcaan Latest Video For "We Caa Done” [Watch]
htmlContent:
Popcaan is back with a new single: "We Caa Done," a collaboration with Drake, and it is expected to appear on the next album of the dancehall superstar, "Great He Is." The project will be out later this month [January 27th] on all streaming platforms via OVO Sound.

The collaboration was a co-production between TRESOR and Batundi. It is accompanied by a video directed by Theo Skudra and filmed on Turks and Caicos, according to consequence.net.

“‘We Caa Done’ is all about persevering,” Popcaan said in a statement. “We don’t think about limits. We’re living the life we’ve dreamed of, and despite what the haters and naysayers have to say, we will only be greater.”

Two-time Finals MVP and Brooklyn Nets forward Kevin Durant also make an cameo appearance in the music below.

On Drake's Instagram post caption reads, "UNRULY OVO FIRST SONG OF 2023 OUT NOW." And Popcaan commented, "Flamesss."

Speaking of Kevin Durant, he and the Nets are the hottest team in the NBA, as they are 12-1 in their last 13 games. They were on a 12-game winning streak before losing to the Bulls on Wednesday night. Durant had 44 points, but it was not enough to overcome the Bulls.

"I felt like a lot of times we chased them a bit, and that was just consistent throughout the whole game, us just playing from behind," Durant said after the game. "I think we definitely put our foot on the gas in spurts ... but they made shots. They're talented players, special players. When you've got your whole five in double figures, it's tough to stop that."
